=== about
The svg namespace: a fragment such as circle becomes an SVG element.
=== page
<svg id="chart"><g id="g"></g></svg>
=== input
event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #g
data: namespace svg
data: elements <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="4"/>

=== dom
<svg id="chart"><g id="g"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="4"></circle></g></svg>
